title: Painted wooden protective insert · Carter 175
creator: Codex · geometry and textures written directly in code
method: Deterministic annular shells swept along a gently curved centerline; no Meshy generation
placement: Recorded in the burial chamber’s southeast corner under lamp 173. Displayed on the approach floor at the burial entrance for access; this is a teaching offset from the recorded findspot.
interpretation: Created by duplicating the silver trumpet outer profile and giving it solid ends, a wooden tip and separate red, blue-green and ochre painted lotus textures. This is a reference-based teaching reconstruction of the wooden protective insert, not a second ancient trumpet. Shares the 58 cm modeling envelope for comparison; exact insert dimensions, pigment loss, unseen pattern and geometry are approximate.
artwork: 128×128 code-drawn icon; not PixelLab or AI-generated artwork
licenseStatus: New code-drawn geometry and ornament created for this project; museum photographs used as visual references only, with no photographic pixels embedded.
